notes.title: HUGE Q.U.I.R.K. Content Update!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/85be16076f92f0bbabb42eea5ae8dd8a57f4c071.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/9ed9384088a1b3c9ad0da8ab36af610509272fae.png[/img][/url]
You all have been so patient while our dev team worked on Q.U.I.R.K. for Mobile and with that going so well we’ve finally been able to focus and give Q.U.I.R.K. for steam the love and care it and you deserve! Please enjoy our latest Q.U.I.R.K. Update featuring….

[u][h1]New Avatar Items[/h1][/u]
Enjoy [b]over 50[/b] brand new avatar items!
[list]
[*]9 new Faces
[*]10 new Hair styles
[*]10 New Facial Hair
[*]11 New Shirts
[*]11 New Pants
[*]11 New Hand Accessories 
[*]11 New Shoes
[*]11 New Hats
[*]21 New Face Accessories 
[*]10 New Back Accessories
[/list]

[u][h1] New Blocks and Props[/h1][/u]
Brand new pallets with [b]over 20[/b] new Blocks and Props.

Get creative with brand new blues, teals, greens and purples or decorate your maps with heart balloons and tulips! 
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/e1580a4e4b3bc76e40359bc7bd92c0e1557da310.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/d78e8153bed413e1914fc75e9667c58ac4b42524.png[/img][/url]

[u][h1]Color Facelift[/h1][/u]
Q.U.I.R.K. has never looked so vibrant with a color overhaul.

All Avatar, Blocks, Props, Weapons have been brightened making all colors pop whether you're making a master piece in Build Mode or dominating the battlefield in Quick Match.

[u][h1] Known Issues [/h1][/u]
Our team is currently working on these issues and will update when they are fixed.
[list]
[*] Game crashes on entering Avatar customization  [b]MAC only[/b]
[*] Skin colors appear large first time opening Avatar customization . Resizes after going to another tab then back. 
[*] Option to take glasses off currently missing [/*]
[/list]

Not seeing the updates? Don't fret, just restart Q.U.I.R.K!

For more updates, announcements and jokes don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Play_QUIRK] Twitter [/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/playQUIRK/] Facebook [/url],[url=https://www.instagram.com/ugen_unlocked/?hl=en] Instagram [/url] or join the community directly at our [url=Discord.gg/Quirk] Discord [/url] 

Of course, if you run into any problems big or small please send us a note so we can help fix it for you. Send us a message at support@ugenworld.com

notes.title: Winner of Choose the Next Weapon poll!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/df507a20a1d8105ac7918c41f625ae591d4112e8.png[/img]
Last week we had a burning question "What weapon do we want to make next?"  The team decided to take that question to the community and we were not disappointed.

I am very excited to announce the winner of last week’s twitter poll, between the Block Gun, Baddie Gun and Buff gun is.... *Drum roooollll* 

[h1]THE BADDIE GUN![/h1]

You guys asked for it and we are getting to work on the Baddie Gun, enjoy growing your own minions to fight for you soon.

Don’t worry the Buff and Block gun won’t be forgotten and we are still happily taking suggestions and comments! 

Thank you everyone for your feedback and for voting.

notes.title: Choose the next weapon in Q.U.I.R.K!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/be1d40b6f70ed1cc10cdc83bc38b2337af18d331.jpg[/img]

We couldn't make up our minds, so we need a little community help. So our team has decided to put the next weapon to be made and put in game in [b] your[/b] hands! 

Vote now on twitter [url=https://twitter.com/PlayQUIRK/status/887440624974151680] @PlayQUIRK twitch	[/url]  until July 24th when we will announce the winner live on Maker Mondays stream at  [url=Twitch.tv/playQUIRK ] playQUIRK twitch	[/url]

[h1]Block Gun [/h1] Clone any movable blocks in match to use as ammo and fire them at players or build clever defenses.

[h1]Baddie Gun[/h1] Spawn an army of Baddies to fight by your side.

[h1]Buff Gun[/h1] Pick up any buff on players or from chests and give them to allies.

Not only do you get to pick which gets made next but we are also listening to feedback on how the guns should work. Should the Block Gun have 20 starting ammo? Maybe the Baddie Gun fires bigger baddies the lower the ammo is? Should we be able to steal our allies buffs as well as our enemies? 

Comment below or send us a tweet we want to know!

Don't forget to spread the word and help shape the future of Q.U.I.R.K.

notes.title: NEW Expanstion Launch: Capture the Flag!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27991149/2d683670229072282a79efdcb2d4a80badf9a167.png[/img]

[h1]Capture the Flag Expansion is live.[/h1] Q.U.I.R.K's first ever expansion has hit Steam. Team up with friends and fight for the flag in this all new game mode full of content!


[h1]Q.U.I.R.K. SUMMER EXPANSION Quick Notes:[/h1]

[list] [*][b]It's easy to log in now![/b] You told us you needed a quick and easy way to log into the game, so we've changed our system to help new players actively logged in through steam to get into the game faster! 

[*][b]New game type:[/b] Capture the flag! We've built several new capture the flag style maps, called CTF in the match select library. 

[*][b]Massive improvements[/b] in how Q.U.I.R.K. is played when you are using the HTC Vive!  

[*][b]We've moved first person camera[/b] shifting to the p key! It used to be the tab key. It isn't now. Please take a note of it!

[*][b]We've improved the UI[/b] elements that present match and team information to you while you're playing!

[*][b]Tons of new capture the flag blocks and features![/b]

[*][b]Great new Quick Match UI[/b], giving you a better understanding of the matches that are available to you!

[*][b]We separated the build kiosk out[/b], so now when you want to build, just run over to the BUILD kiosk to try out the new blocks!

[*][b]We've moved the Quick Match[/b] kiosk to the top of the platform in the middle of the commons. Jump in! Play! Win!

[*][b]New splash screens[/b] for the Summer Expansion.

[*][b]You can now see real-time updates[/b] to your map voting! Play often, vote often! Maps with the most votes get to claim the honor of being placed in the quick-match queue!

[*][b]You can now UNDO[/b] the rotation action while building!

[*][b]The commons area is now 10%[/b] more interesting with white picket fences.

[*][b]We've added fireworks[/b] to the commons area! Run over them, hammer them, or throw something at them, and they'll shoot off into the air and explode in the sky, showering everyone in the commons with magical stars.

[*][b]We've turned the Kiosks into BBQ's![/b][/list]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[list] [*] [b]New Play mode[/b]: Capture the Flag. Grab the flag, fight through the enemy team to the score pads, hold your ground for points to win.

[*][b]New Commons area [/b]: Enjoy a fresh new look in the commons with play and build mode now neatly separated and easy to get to.

[*][b]New Blocks:[/b] Build your Capture the Flag maps with the all new Flag Spawner, Goal Maker, Ramp, Small Ramp, Dash Ramp Up, Dash Ramp Down, Dash Pad and Breakable Sphere.

[*][b]New Buffs:[/b] Get an edge in match with Infinite Sprint, Invisibility Buff and Ammo Reload Buff.

[*][b]New Avatar Animations:[/b] Express yourself to other players with a friendly Wave or Thumbs up! Eeeeeeeeyyy!

[*][b]New Website:[/b] Yes, its not an in game deal but seriously its so pretty [url=https://www.playquirk.com/] Playquirk.com (http://playquirk.com/) [/url]
[/list]

But wait there's more! For a full list of what is now in Q.U.I.R.K. Capture the Flag expansion check out [url=https://support.playquirk.com/hc/en-us/articles/115009827388-Patch-Notes-for-the-Soft-Launch-of-Operation-Capture-Freedom-] Patch Notes [/url]

Not seeing the updates? Restart your game and update silly!

Of course if you run into any problems big or small please send us a note so we can help fix it for you.
 [url=https://support.playquirk.com/hc/en-us] QUIRK Support [/url]


For more updates, announcements and jokes don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Play_QUIRK] Twitter [/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/playQUIRK/] Facebook [/url] or join the community directly at our [url=Discord.gg/Ugen] Discord [/url]

Happy Capturing!

notes.title: Update Your Client for the New Q.U.I.R.K. Build! Fast Login is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Load, Click, Play, Quick![/h1]
You've asked us to make it simpler to launch and play Q.U.I.R.K.  and we've listened! We used to ask for new users to create an account in order to load and play Q.U.I.R.K., but we've removed that requirement so you can dive in and play immediately! 

For those of you that are currently in game, you'll want to log out and update your client to see the new changes. 

The change is live now and we're excited to hear your feedback. 

This is one of the final big changes for the Q.U.I.R.K. Summer Expansion, due to officially launch on Monday, July 17th. If you run into any bugs or have questions for us, send an email to support@ugenworld.com, or hit reply here! We're looking forward to hearing from you.

notes.title: Patch Notes: THE BUILD-A-PALOOZA BUILD!
notes.content:
This week's update includes a slew of improvements for our builders, as well as some great optimizations for players on the PC, MacOS and HTC Vive! 

This thread offers the complete build notes, but you can also find them at the [url=https://support.playquirk.com/hc/en-us/articles/115009009227-Patch-notes-BUILD-A-PALOOZA-] QUIRK support portal [/url]. Leave a reply below for any questions or comments! 

You can also find the entire block library, with descriptions and information by clicking the following link: [url=https://support.playquirk.com/hc/en-us/articles/115009009227#BlockLibrary]THE QUIRK BLOCK LIBRARY LINK![/url] 

[b]HEY![/b] [i]Don't forget to join us Friday, June 16th at 4p Pacific for Happy Hour, as we play in-game with our pal and happy hour stream host Pootloops![/i]

Read on for the complete [b]BUILD-A-PALOOZA PATCH NOTES![/b] 

[h1]Improvements in VR for HTC Vive Players:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The create account bug has been fixed! Please send a note to support@ugenworld.com (mailto:support@ugenworld.com) if you run into any trouble
[*] Jetpack flight speed has been raised for VR players so that they are as fast as MacOS and PC players
[*] The melee hammer no longer persists across sessions in VR
[*] Added better descriptions to the Edit tools in the build menu
[*] Shield and Strength buffs have been reduced in size so that VR (and PC players in 1st Person) players can see better when buffed
[*] Muzzle flash has been reduced in size so that VR (and PC players in 1st Person) players can see better while the effect plays
[*] Controller labels have been optimized for VR players
[/list]

[h1]New Fun in the Commons![/h1]
[list]
[*]Try out the catapult and the new mini-game! Shoot blocks, balls, [i]and other players[/i] through the sky-hoops! All you have to do is place (or ask) the thing you want to shoot into the ammo trough, and then jump into the catapult! Holding down the left mouse button will increase the speed and strength of your shot. 
[*] Look for the grappling hooks! 
[*] Added a high-dive (whoa VR!) 
[*] Moved Kiosks around, added a pretty fountain, some apple trees, tons of green balls and a bouncy house with way more bounce! 
[*] Updated and improved the bowling lanes!
[/list]

[h1]New Block Point System![/h1]
The biggest news of the day has to be the introduction of the new block point system. You said you wanted all the blocks, and we listened! Now, rather than requiring you to level up to get access to new and exciting blocks, we’ve given everyone access to all the blocks. Sort of. Let us explain: 

[h1]New Point System Quick Notes:[/h1] 
[list]
[*] Players now have access to all the available blocks!
[*] Each type of block has been assigned a point cost
[*] Players have budget of 8800 points to spend when building
[/list]

[h1]No More Leveling Up For Blocks![/h1]
We’ve replaced the old level up system with a new point system that assigns a point value to each block based on that block’s impact on things like game play and processor power. This means the more powerful blocks (and the blocks that are known to bring even the beefiest rig to its knees when placed by the hundreds) cost more for builders to use. Common blocks cost less, which means you can use a lot more of them to build your creations. 

[h1]Builder’s Tool Update Quick Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Big usability improvements to the builder’s tools!
[*]Introducing 13 new and improved block and props (see the Block Library for descriptions) that bring a whole new level of customization and creativity to building. 
[*] Extensive backend engineering work to make it easier for us to give you new building blocks!
[*]Tons of graphic optimizations that improve both game play and performance on PC, MacOS and the HTC Vive
[/list]

[h1]Better Build Palettes![/h1]
We’ve reorganized and improved the current build palettes so that they are much easier for our builder’s to use. This includes a sorely needed update on our names and descriptions, a slick new menu interface and improved the graphic performance of the building palettes.


[h1]13 New and Improved Blocks for Builders![/h1]
[list]
[*]Sticky Moving Platform: must place two. Invisible platform that travels between two placement points carrying all connected blocks with it
[*]Trampoline Block: Bounces players, baddies, and projectiles on impact. Cannot be moved or destroyed by players
[*]Player Respawn Point: Randomized respawn points for players coming back to life 
[*]Sticky Rotating Platform : spinning platform that will rotate any connected blocks
[*]6 Note Blocks: 6 colors play 6 notes when touched:
[list]
[*]The red block plays a note in the key of A when touched
[*]The orange block plays a note in the key  of B when touched
[*]The yellow block plays a note in the key  of D Flat when touched
[*]The green block plays a note int he key  of E when touched
[*]The blue block plays note in the key of F  Sharp when touched
[*]The purple block plays a note in the key  of A when touched
[/list]
[*]Green Sphere: can be moved but not destroyed by  players
[*]Jetpack: Now flies faster for VR players. Allows players to fly if they are wearing it on their back
[*]Stun Gun changed to Toast-A-Lizer: now with 10 shots. Players hold this to fire electric sparks  that temporarily slow enemy players and baddies. 
[*]Bouncy Block: We've added some serious bounce to this block, making it the bounciest bounce ever for players. 
[*]Catapult: This new weapon allows you to load up blocks and fire them at people. Or, you can load up people and fire them at blocks! 
[/list]

[h1]More Blocks Coming![/h1]
This update also introduces some back-end work on our block selections that will allow us to add a variety of different colors, functions, and features to your block options more quickly and cleanly than before. This means we will be introducing even more new blocks in the very near future (stay tuned for the last week of June for those!).

Updated and improved the bowling lanes!
Players now have access to all the available blocks!
Each type of block has been assigned a point cost
Players have budget of 8800 points to spend when building

We’ve replaced the old level up system with a new point system that assigns a point value to each block based on that block’s impact on things like game play and processor power. This means the more powerful blocks (and the blocks that are known to bring even the beefiest rig to its knees when placed by the hundreds) cost more for builders to use. Common blocks cost less, which means you can use a lot more of them to build your creations.
Big usability improvements to the builder’s tools!
Introducing 13 new and improved block and props (see the Block Library for descriptions) that bring a whole new level of customization and creativity to building.
Extensive backend engineering work to make it easier for us to give you new building blocks!
Tons of graphic optimizations that improve both game play and performance on PC, MacOS and the HTC Vive

We’ve reorganized and improved the current build palettes so that they are much easier for our builder’s to use. This includes a sorely needed update on our names and descriptions, a slick new menu interface and improved the graphic performance of the building palettes.
Sticky Moving Platform: must place two. Invisible platform that travels between two placement points carrying all connected blocks with it
Trampoline Block: Bounces players, baddies, and projectiles on impact. Cannot be moved or destroyed by players
Player Respawn Point: Randomized respawn points for players coming back to life
Sticky Rotating Platform : spinning platform that will rotate any connected blocks
6 Note Blocks: 6 colors play 6 notes when touched:
The red block plays a note in the key of A when touched
The orange block plays a note in the key  of B when touched
The yellow block plays a note in the key  of D Flat when touched
The green block plays a note int he key  of E when touched
The blue block plays note in the key of F  Sharp when touched
The purple block plays a note in the key  of A when touched
Green Sphere: can be moved but not destroyed by  players
Jetpack: Now flies faster for VR players. Allows players to fly if they are wearing it on their back

tags.balance_change: Stun Gun changed to Toast-A-Lizer: now with 10 shots. Players hold this to fire electric sparks  that temporarily slow enemy players and baddies.

tags.feature: Bouncy Block: We've added some serious bounce to this block, making it the bounciest bounce ever for players.
Catapult: This new weapon allows you to load up blocks and fire them at people. Or, you can load up people and fire them at blocks!

This update also introduces some back-end work on our block selections that will allow us to add a variety of different colors, functions, and features to your block options more quickly and cleanly than before. This means we will be introducing even more new blocks in the very near future (stay tuned for the last week of June for those!).

notes.title: **Update** Service Restored! Q.U.I.R.K. Services (Were) Temporarily Down, Solution Imminent!
notes.content:
We apologize for the inconvenience! We are actively tracking a 3rd party network outage that prevents everyone (include ourselves!) from connecting and playing Q.U.I.R.K. The good news is that our partner has been providing regular updates on their work to resolve the issue, and by all accounts, we should all see a full recovery in short order. 

While it isn't unusual for technical glitches to pop up outside of our ability to fix them, we do take outages very seriously. So, as a way of thanking you for your patience, we are sending every member of our community a complimentary Q.U.I.R.K. key on Steam that you can gift to a friend of your choice. 

We will continue to keep you apprised as we learn more. Once the service is functioning and stable, we'll ship your Q.U.I.R.K. keys via email. 

Questions or concerns? Drop a note in this thread!

notes.title: New Q.U.I.R.K. Build 00.05.69
notes.content:
[h1]Build Notes for Build 00.05.69[/h1]

We'll be pushing the new build today, Friday, April 7th! Look for Steam to update your client at around 2p Pacific. 

[b]Kiosks Labels:[/b] When you first log in to Q.U.I.R.K, you are placed in a lobby/waiting space that we call The Commons. When you face the giant Q.U.I.R.K. in the sky, you will find see the labeled kiosks that will take you to different areas of the game. 

[b]Basic Audio Options are Here:[/b] Run into the SETTINGS kiosk, and check out the new menu options that allow you to turn off the Audio and the Sound Effects. No more loud music in your face! In the future, we’ll add finer controls that will allow you to adjust the volume as well. 

[b]QUICKMATCH:[/b] Entering the kiosk with the lightening bolt will kick off a rotating series of Q.U.I.R.K.s that are curated by the uGen team. We often take the maps we enjoy the most and promote them to QUICKMATCH so that people get more exposure to them. We are currently designing new and different ways to for players to access newly created or popular Q.U.I.R.K.s, so keep your eye open for changes to this system in the future.  

[b]TUTORIAL:[/b] Entering the kiosk with the graduate’s cap showcases our first stab at a tutorial space. We’ve set up some billboards with basic instructions to help coach you through things like movement, using and picking up items, firing weapons, and building. Jump in, check it out, and let us know if you’ve got some suggestions to make this experience better. Please note: The TUTORIAL (or LAIROTUT if you are looking at it backwards) is a work in progress, and will change dramatically over the next few months. 

[b]SETTINGS:[/b] Entering the kiosks with the spinning gears gives you the options to adjust the gender of your avatar, your graphics quality, Movement when you are in VR, as well as display and audio settings. Like all things in this early phase of game development, you might see some strange behavior when playing with Graphics or Display properties. 

[b]PLAY & BUILD:[/b] The kiosk with the crossed hammers opens up what we call the Q.U.I.R.K. index. It is basically a library showing you all the maps you have access too. We’ve broken those maps, or Q.U.I.R.K.s, down into smaller categories in an effort to make things easier to find. This section has a total redesign in the works, so expect some dramatic improvements in the future. Here are the current categories and their purpose:   

[olist]
[*][b]FEATURED:[/b] This section gives you access to the build function, which you’ll see as a bright cyan (fancy light blue!) tile that says BUILD NEW QUIRK. That tile is followed by a collection of maps that we’ve handpicked because we think you’ll enjoy them. Once you’ve selected that map, your friends can join you by checking the ACTIVE MATCHES tab and then clicking on your map. Players can also join you directly with an invite through Steam (if they’ve got Q.U.I.R.K. installed), or by joining the match and clicking on your avatar in The Commons. 

[*][b]MY QUIRKS:[/b] This section ALSO gives you access to the build function, which you’ll see as a bright cyan (fancy light blue!) tile that says BUILD NEW QUIRK. It also shows all of the maps you’ve built in the last stage that you last saved them. This is the menu you can use to submit your final Q.U.I.R.K. design to us for approval! Once we’ve approved your submission, everyone can play it by sorting through the RATINGS section. 
When you hover over a tile in your MY QUIRK library, you will get three options represented by the following symbols: 

[list]
[*][b]Hammer and Wrench:[/b] Puts you back in build mode for that [*]Q.U.I.R.K.
[*][b]Upload Arrow:[/b] Submits your Q.U.I.R.K. to us for approval and sharing with the public. 
[*][b]Garbage Can:[/b] Careful! This Deletes your Q.U.I.R.K., and in some cases, we aren’t able to get it back for you. 
[/list]

[*][b]ACTIVE MATCHES:[/b] This shows you all the active matches you are able to join.  
[*][b]RATINGS:[/b] This shows all the Q.U.I.R.K.s that you can play and rate!  
 
Let us know in this thread if you've got any questions!
